title: fix(app-shell): a record locked by an approval is shown locked to a reader outside that approval
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99vermfGkBLv9Vtsw2EJzVK)_
Fixes #25934

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 记录页在审批列表里找不到待审单时，再问一次服务器"这条记录锁了吗"(`client.approvals.getRecordLock`);答"锁了"就按锁定显示：编辑置灰、不给行内编辑、显示"审批锁定"横幅且不显示撤回按钮。
- **为什么改:** 能读记录但不在审批名单上的成员，读审批列表永远是空的，页面就当"没在审批",让他双击编辑，保存时才被服务器 409 拒绝(裁决 A,6422939157)。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改 app-shell 两个文件，不动导出类型和服务端;每次打开没有可见待审单的记录多一个 GET 请求。没有审批服务的部署该接口答 501,行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`(`lockedForReader` 与撤回按钮的 `approvalIsSubmitter`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useRecordApprovals.ts`(`startRead` 里的锁读取)、新测试 `RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

The approvals list (`GET /approvals/requests?object=…&recordId=…`) serves a request only to its participants, so a member who can read a record but is not on its approval read that list as `200 { data: [] }` while a `lockRecord: true` approval held the record. The record page took the answered empty read for "no approval is running" (rule 2 of `resolveApprovalLock`) and offered inline edit, and the save answered `409 RECORD_LOCKED`.

Ruling A (6422939157) added a lock signal every reader can see: `GET /approvals/records/:object/:recordId/lock` and `client.approvals.getRecordLock` (#26314, PR #26361), answering `{ locked }` only. This PR is the console half.

- `useRecordApprovals` (app-shell): when the list read finds no pending request, the shared read also calls `client.approvals.getRecordLock(object, recordId)` through the mounted adapter's client (no hand-rolled URL), and the result carries `recordLock: { locked } | null`. A pending request the viewer can see still decides and the lock is not read. With no adapter mounted, the lock read is skipped. A lock read that never answered (`501` without the approvals service) leaves `null`; a later failure keeps the last answer, as the rows are kept.
- `RecordDetailView` (lock region only): `{ locked: true }` from the record lock is fed to `resolveApprovalLock` as its open approval. That is rule 1's input exactly, since the server answers `true` only when a pending request from a node whose `lockRecord` is not `false` exists. So the page reads locked and pending, Edit is disabled and `canEdit` is false. No lock answer means no open approval, so rule 2 is unchanged for a composition without the approvals service. For a lock known only from the record lock, `approvalIsSubmitter` is `false`: the reader cannot read the request, and its submitter always can, so the band offers no recall lever.
- No change to `ui/packages/react` (`resolveApprovalLock` / `ApprovalLockInput` need no new input, because the signal is rule 1's input) or to `ui/packages/plugin-detail` (the `DetailView` band computes from the host's threaded `locked` / `approvalPending` / `approvalIsSubmitter`, it does not compute its own lock input). No sdui record is written: app-shell is not a registry package, and the per-package records are retired (#26367).
- `Clause-②: no`: the claim graded it `yes (widening)` provisionally, on the assumption that `ApprovalLockInput` would gain an input. It does not. The one type that gains a member, the hook's result interface, is not reachable from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry: `src/index.ts` does not re-export `useRecordApprovals` and the interface is not exported. This was measured on the source entry. The app-shell `dist` was not built in this container.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalLock-25934.test.tsx` (same probe as `RecordDetailView.approvalLock-12220`, record with no `approval_status` mirror, like showcase):
  - a non-participant (list `200` empty, lock `{ locked: true }`) gets `locked`, `approvalPending`, `canEdit: false`, `approvalIsSubmitter: false`, and the lock is read with the page's object and record id;
  - lock `{ locked: false }` opens editable;
  - lock read refused `501` (no approvals service) opens editable, the answered empty read is not locked;
  - a participant's pending `lock_record: false` row decides (pending, editable) and the lock is not read.
- The objectui#12220 tests are unchanged and green: `RecordDetailView.approvalLock-12220.test.tsx`, `useRecordApprovals.answered-12220.test.tsx` (and `resolveApprovalLock-12220.test.ts` / `DetailView.approvalReadAnswered-12220.test.tsx`, whose packages this diff does not touch). No test edit was forced.

## Acceptance notes

- One extra `GET` per record open where the list finds no pending request. It goes through the adapter's authenticated, settle-counted client fetch.
- The lock read starts with the list read on mount and on `refresh()`. An adapter mounted only after the record's first read gets no lock until the next refresh. The console's `AdapterProvider` mounts the adapter before the record page reads.

## Verification

- **Premises (re-run before any edit, origin/main `61c07986`).** 1: `InlineEditContext.tsx:107` rule 2 holds. 2: `resolveApprovalLock({` at `RecordDetailView.tsx:1664` and `DetailView.tsx:1716`. 3: the only lock source was the list read, `useRecordApprovals.ts:480`. 6: `lifecycle-hooks.ts` beforeUpdate `:538`, `lockedError(recordLockRefusal` `:633`, refusal text `:294`. 7: `lock_record?: boolean` at `approval-service.ts:336`. 9: PR #26053 merged (`054652bf`), so the serial condition is met. Line numbers drifted, and every substance held.
- **Final head `fca25b0b`, one locked run:** `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (64/64), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`), then 4 files: the new test, `RecordDetailView.approvalLock-12220`, `useRecordApprovals.answered-12220`, `RecordDetailView.approvalRecallGate`. Test Files 4/4, Tests 25/25, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Neighbours (pre-merge head `e0f9e560`):** all 71 `RecordDetailView.*.test.tsx`, the `useRecordApprovals*` hook tests, `RecordApprovalsPanel*` and `AppContent.recordSaveToastNamesRecord-26172`. Test Files 82/82, Tests 551/551, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The full app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`.
- **Ablation.** The fix was committed, then `useRecordApprovals.ts` and `RecordDetailView.tsx` were restored to the base `61c07986` (on disk: `getRecordLock` 3→0, `lockedForReader` 3→0). The new test's non-participant case went red at `:235` (`expected 'false' to be 'true'`, `locked`). Both lock-read cases went red because `getRecordLock` was never called. The participant control stayed green: Tests 3 failed / 1 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 1`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hashes equal HEAD's. app-shell tests import the source directly, so no dist leg applies.
- **Gates on `fca25b0b`:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 35. All 35 exit 0, `check:type-check-debt` included. `--ran`: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Roster gate under `.changeset`: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs` exit 0. All other families: this PR's check-runs.
